fact: On 18 October 2023 the Ministry's planning bureau (BPSE) held a workshop validating the collection forms for a rapid-reporting data platform, with data collected in real time and sent to a central server at the start of the school year and each term.
title: Atelier de validation des fiches de collecte des données a remontée rapide.
publisher: Ministère de l'Education Nationale et de la Recherche Scientifique (MENRS)
